about.intro-lead: A Guangzhou clothing factory with ready-made wholesale, private label and custom manufacturing. Built around the way you buy.
about.who-title:
From Guangzhou,
for your next collection.
about.who-body: Sourcyo Apparel makes T-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts and casualwear sets for wholesalers, independent brands, online retailers and importers. Alongside our factory, we run a wholesale stall with warehousing and dispatch services.
about.who-options: Start with existing styles. Add your own label to blanks, choose decoration, or develop a custom garment around your requirements.
about.products-body: 240 GSM cotton drop-shoulder tees. 430 GSM cotton fleece hoodies. Crewnecks, zip-up hoodies, stand-collar jackets and hoodie sets. S–5XL across the range, depending on style; check each product’s cm size chart.
about.ways-title:
Start with wholesale.
Grow into your own label.
about.ways-body-01: Buy ready-made styles as pictured. From {moq} pieces; mix styles in your wholesale order.
about.ways-body-02: Choose blank styles and add your neck labels, hang tags or packaging. From {moq} pieces per style; mix colours and sizes.
about.ways-body-03: Add printing, embroidery, heat transfer or your logo. From {moq} pieces per style; mix colours and sizes.
about.ways-body-04: Develop the fit, fabric, weight or dyeing. From {moq} pieces; quoted to your materials and requirements.
about.brand-title:
Make it yours.
Check a sample first.
about.brand-body: Neck labels, hang tags and packaging can carry your brand. Printing, embroidery and heat transfer add the decoration you need. Samples let you review the garment, fabric, fit and finish before confirming your order.
about.brand-capabilities:
Printing · Embroidery
Labels & packaging · Fabric & build
about.visit-title:
See samples at our stall.
Visit the factory by appointment.
about.stall-address: Room 1401, Building B8, Jindong International Garment City, Shijing Town, Baiyun District, Guangzhou.
about.stall-visit: Samples and reception are at the stall. Please arrange factory visits in advance so we can accompany you.
about.stall-role: Our Guangzhou operations cover manufacturing, ready-stock wholesale, warehousing and order dispatch.
about.order-quote-body: Prices depend on the style, quantity, materials and decoration. Send your requirements for a tailored quotation.
about.order-sample-body: Samples can be arranged to check garment measurements, fabric and decoration before confirming the order.
about.order-ship-body: Worldwide dispatch from Guangzhou. Choose your Chinese FOB port; your own forwarder is welcome. Costs and handover are confirmed in the quote and order.
